friday.en: Our class will submit the final report on friday afternoon.
friday.zh: 我們班將在星期五下午繳交最後報告。

humbly.en: She humbly thanked the volunteers for helping with the event.
humbly.zh: 她謙虛地感謝志工協助這場活動。

humiliation.en: The novel shows how public humiliation can damage trust between people.
humiliation.zh: 小說呈現公開羞辱如何傷害人與人之間的信任。

humorously.en: The speaker humorously described a mistake from his first job.
humorously.zh: 講者幽默地描述他第一份工作中的一次失誤。

hurl.en: Strong winds can hurl loose leaves across the playground.
hurl.zh: 強風會把鬆散的樹葉吹過操場。

hurrah.en: The students shouted hurrah when their team won the quiz.
hurrah.zh: 隊伍贏得問答比賽時，學生高喊萬歲。

hymn.en: The music class studied the structure of a traditional hymn.
hymn.zh: 音樂課研究一首傳統聖歌的結構。

hyphen.en: Use a hyphen when the writing guide requires one.
hyphen.zh: 寫作指南要求時請使用連字號。

hypocrisy.en: The essay criticizes hypocrisy between public words and private actions.
hypocrisy.zh: 這篇文章批評公開言論與私下行動之間的虛偽。

hysterical.en: The comedy scene became hysterical after several unexpected misunderstandings.
hysterical.zh: 幾個意外誤會後，喜劇場面變得非常滑稽。

gaiety.en: Bright decorations added a sense of gaiety to the festival.
gaiety.zh: 鮮豔裝飾為節慶增添歡樂氣氛。

gemini.en: The astronomy club discussed gemini while identifying winter constellations.
gemini.zh: 天文社辨認冬季星座時討論了雙子座。

generalize.en: We should not generalize from one unusual example alone.
generalize.zh: 我們不應只根據一個特殊例子做概括。

glassware.en: The laboratory stores clean glassware in a labeled cabinet.
glassware.zh: 實驗室把乾淨玻璃器皿放在有標示的櫃子裡。

goldfish.en: A goldfish swam slowly around the classroom aquarium.
goldfish.zh: 一隻金魚在教室水族箱裡緩緩游動。

goodness.en: The story emphasizes kindness, fairness, and simple human goodness.
goodness.zh: 故事強調善良、公平與單純的人性美好。

grandchild.en: The photograph shows a grandchild reading beside a grandparent.
grandchild.zh: 照片中一名孫輩正在祖父母身旁閱讀。

granddaughter.en: Her granddaughter helped organize the family photo album.
granddaughter.zh: 她的孫女幫忙整理家庭相簿。

grandson.en: His grandson visits the library with him every Saturday.
grandson.zh: 他的孫子每週六和他一起去圖書館。

grate.en: The old metal grate covers a drain beside the road.
grate.zh: 舊金屬格柵蓋住道路旁的排水口。

gravestone.en: The historian photographed an old gravestone for the local archive.
gravestone.zh: 歷史學者拍下舊墓碑供地方檔案保存。

graveyard.en: The documentary examines a historic graveyard beside the old church.
graveyard.zh: 紀錄片探討老教堂旁的一處歷史墓園。

greatness.en: The biography questions how people define true greatness.
greatness.zh: 這本傳記探討人們如何定義真正的偉大。

grove.en: The class rested in a small grove beside the trail.
grove.zh: 全班在步道旁的小樹林休息。

handbook.en: The student handbook explains the school's main rules clearly.
handbook.zh: 學生手冊清楚說明學校主要規定。

happening.en: Something unusual is happening near the science building today.
happening.zh: 今天科學大樓附近正在發生不尋常的事。

happiness.en: The survey asked students what contributes most to happiness.
happiness.zh: 調查詢問學生什麼最能帶來幸福感。

hardy.en: These hardy plants can survive cold mountain weather.
hardy.zh: 這些耐寒植物能在寒冷山區天氣中生存。

hare.en: A hare crossed the field before disappearing into tall grass.
hare.zh: 一隻野兔穿過田野後消失在高草中。

harshly.en: The teacher reminded students not to judge others harshly.
harshly.zh: 老師提醒學生不要過度嚴厲地評斷他人。

hastily.en: He hastily submitted the file before checking the final page.
hastily.zh: 他還沒檢查最後一頁就匆忙交了檔案。

heading.en: Add a clear heading above each section of the report.
heading.zh: 在報告每個段落上方加上清楚標題。

head-on.en: The article compares two competing ideas head-on.
head-on.zh: 這篇文章直接比較兩個競爭中的觀點。

hearsay.en: The reporter separated confirmed facts from hearsay in the article.
hearsay.zh: 記者在文章中區分已證實事實與傳聞。

heavier.en: This box is heavier than the one we moved yesterday.
heavier.zh: 這個箱子比昨天搬的那個更重。

heavyweight.en: The debate featured a heavyweight scholar known for economic research.
heavyweight.zh: 辯論邀請了一位以經濟研究聞名的重量級學者。

heiress.en: The novel follows an heiress who chooses an independent life.
heiress.zh: 小說描述一名女繼承人選擇獨立生活。

herald.en: Many people saw the invention as a herald of major change.
herald.zh: 許多人把這項發明視為重大改變的先兆。

hesitantly.en: She hesitantly raised her hand to ask a difficult question.
hesitantly.zh: 她猶豫地舉手詢問一個困難問題。

hinder.en: Poor communication can hinder progress on a group project.
hinder.zh: 溝通不良會妨礙小組專題進度。

hollywood.en: The media class studied hollywood films from several decades.
hollywood.zh: 媒體課研究了數個年代的好萊塢電影。

homeless.en: The service project collected blankets for homeless people in winter.
homeless.zh: 服務活動在冬季為無家者募集毛毯。

horrifying.en: The documentary described a horrifying natural disaster without graphic images.
horrifying.zh: 紀錄片以非血腥畫面描述了一場可怕的天然災害。

id.en: Students must show a school id when borrowing equipment.
id.zh: 學生借用設備時必須出示學生證。

ideological.en: The course compares ideological differences among historical movements.
ideological.zh: 這門課比較不同歷史運動之間的意識形態差異。

illness.en: The article explains how illness can affect school attendance.
illness.zh: 文章說明疾病如何影響到校出席。

illogical.en: The conclusion seems illogical because it ignores the main evidence.
illogical.zh: 這個結論忽略主要證據，因此顯得不合邏輯。

immoral.en: The novel portrays cheating for personal gain as immoral.
immoral.zh: 小說把為個人利益作弊描寫成不道德的行為。

impair.en: Loud background noise can impair concentration during study.
impair.zh: 吵雜背景聲可能降低讀書時的專注力。

impatient.en: He became impatient while waiting for the delayed bus.
impatient.zh: 等候誤點公車時，他開始感到不耐煩。
